mapper.select: SELECT m.*, r.id AS r_id, r.message_id AS r_message_id, r.content AS r_content, r.create_time AS r_create_time FROM t_message m LEFT JOIN t_reply r ON m.id = r.message_id ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, r.create_time ASC

SELECT m.*, r.id AS r_id, r.message_id AS r_message_id, r.content AS r_content, r.create_time AS r_create_time FROM t_message m LEFT JOIN t_reply r ON m.id = r.message_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, r.create_time ASC
SELECT count(*) FROM t_message WHERE state = '未读'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_message (content, create_time, user_id, username, phone, state) VALUES (#{content}, NOW(), #{userId}, #{username}, #{phone}, '未读')
mapper.update: UPDATE t_message SET state = #{state} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_reply (message_id, content, create_time) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{content}, NOW())
